content.text: In countries like Zimbabwe, where financial isolation and platform restrictions hinder digital commerce, creators need alternative [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/full-infrastructure-guide-kyc-payment-gateways-digital-sellers-3|The Full]] to sell their products online. With Stripe and PayPal inaccessible, the search for a reliable, free, and crypto-friendly solution begins. This guide will walk you through [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/how-deploying-digital-store-cloudflare-pages-free-complete-10|deploying]] a digital store on Cloudflare Pages, using Stack 01 or Stack 02 from COREMERCH, to start [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/selling-courses-pakistan-without-stripe-what-actually-how-9|COREMERCH guide to selling]] your digital products without relying on conventional payment platforms.
Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail

The COREMERCH infrastructure is designed to bypass platform restrictions, offering creators a sovereign way to sell digital products. By leveraging GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting, and integrating with NOWPayments for crypto transactions, you can ensure your store remains operational regardless of external factors. This approach focuses on giving you full ownership and control over your digital commerce stack, eliminating the risk of account suspensions or payment interruptions.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before deploying your digital store, you need to prepare your products, decide on the stack that suits your needs (either Stack 01 for a simpler setup or Stack 02 for a more comprehensive solution), and ensure you have the necessary technical knowledge or support. Understanding the difference between Stack 01 and Stack 02, such as the use of Cloudflare Workers and Supabase in Stack 02, will help you make an informed decision. Stack 01 can be deployed following the Sovereign Blueprint in 4-6 hours, while Stack 02 is deployed by COREMERCH in 48 hours, including end-to-end testing.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

Setting up your payment pipeline involves integrating NOWPayments into your store. This allows you to accept over 300 cryptocurrencies with a minimal fee of 0.5% per transaction. For delivery, you can use Google Drive or Cloudflare R2, ensuring instant product delivery to your customers. The payment and delivery process is automated, reducing the complexity of managing digital product sales and allowing you to focus on marketing and customer support.
Deploy your digital store in 48 hours with the Edge Commerce Stack.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Once your store is set up and your payment and delivery pipelines are configured, you can go live. The first transaction is a significant milestone, as it validates your setup and gives you confidence in your infrastructure. With Stack 02, the Edge Commerce Stack, you get 5 products loaded, SPF/DKIM/DMARC configured for email security, and 30-day support to ensure a smooth start. This comprehensive approach helps you overcome the initial hurdles and start selling your digital products quickly.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

After your store is live and you've processed your first transactions, the next step is scaling. This involves optimizing your store for better performance, possibly upgrading your hosting or backend logic, and expanding your product lineup. The COREMERCH infrastructure is designed to be scalable, with guides and support available to help you grow your digital commerce business. Whether you're using Stack 01 or Stack 02, the focus is on ensuring your store can handle increased traffic and sales without compromising performance or security.
How do I build a digital store that accepts crypto payments for free?

To build a digital store that accepts crypto payments for free, you can use Stack 01 from COREMERCH, which integrates GitHub Pages, Apps Script, and NOWPayments. This setup allows you to host your store and process crypto payments with minimal fees, all while maintaining full control over your infrastructure. With the Sovereign Blueprint, you can deploy Stack 01 in 4-6 hours, giving you a quick and reliable way to start selling digital products online.
Accept over 300 cryptocurrencies with NOWPayments integration.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

For those looking for a more comprehensive solution, the Edge Commerce Stack ($197) offers a complete digital commerce setup on Cloudflare Pages, including Workers, Supabase, and NOWPayments integration. You can find more details about this and other products on the COREMERCH products page at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html. This stack is deployed in 48 hours, end-to-end tested, and comes with 30-day support, making it an ideal choice for creators who want a hassle-free and scalable digital store.
Your Deployment Checklist

To deploy your digital store, start by choosing your stack, either Stack 01 for a basic setup or Stack 02 for advanced features. Next, set up your hosting on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, depending on your stack. Then, integrate NOWPayments for crypto transactions and configure your payment pipeline. After that, set up your product delivery using Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. Finally, test your store, ensure everything is working as expected, and go live. For Stack 02, COREMERCH handles the deployment and testing, so you can focus on preparing your products and marketing strategy.
Frequently Asked Questions
What is the main difference between Stack 01 and Stack 02?

Stack 01 is a basic setup using GitHub Pages, Apps Script, and NOWPayments, while Stack 02 is a more advanced setup using Cloudflare Pages, Workers, Supabase, and NOWPayments, offering more features and scalability.
Can I host my digital product store on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for free?
Yes, both GitHub Pages and Cloudflare Pages offer free hosting options that can be used for digital product stores, making them ideal for creators who want to minimize their initial costs.
How long does it take to deploy Stack 01?
Stack 01 can be deployed in 4-6 hours following the Sovereign Blueprint, allowing for a quick setup of your digital store.
What kind of support does the Edge Commerce Stack offer?
The Edge Commerce Stack comes with 30-day support to help you with any issues or questions you might have after deployment, ensuring a smooth start for your digital commerce business.
Is the COREMERCH infrastructure scalable?
Yes, the COREMERCH infrastructure is designed to be scalable, allowing you to grow your digital commerce business without worrying about performance or security issues.
